mutations.label: E1 the announcement is unreachable, so an unreadable served-build stamp is silent again -- #738's stale-bundle check is DISABLED for the round and reports the build clean, which is exactly the blind spot it was written to cover. Fourth file with this shape today (#882, #884, #888)
E2 the say-once latch is inverted, so the FIRST unreadable stamp is suppressed and nothing else sets the flag -- it never announces at all
E3 the permissive default is dropped, so an unreadable stamp leaves whatever `_prev738` already held and #738 compares against stale data. Control
